title: SUMO
description: Documented public traffic simulation (DLR (open source)) for the Transportation Network Optimizer capability area.
body:
SUMO is a documented traffic simulation from DLR (open source). DLR's open-source Simulation of Urban MObility: microscopic traffic simulation used worldwide for signal and policy studies.

How it works: It works by stepping the Nagel-Schreckenberg cellular automaton (accelerate, brake for gap, randomize, move) and measuring average flow.

Documented uses of this capability area include city digital twins, power-grid planning, water-network operations, epidemic modeling, and disaster early warning.
